title: ResearchPattern v1
description: A domain-neutral, reviewable heuristic distilled from one or more case packages (ADR-0007 decisions 2 and 3). A pattern only helps propose hypotheses, check for omissions, and select tools: it never establishes any conclusion for the current run, which must re-verify and record the actual outcome as a reuse-event/v1 record. Lifecycle transitions are append-only: each transition is a new record version with a new pattern_id, an ID-only supersedes pointer to its predecessor, a status snapshot, and a mandatory transition rationale. Earlier versions are never edited in place.

summary.description: Short normalized statement of the problem shape this pattern addresses.

signature_sha256.description: Exact fingerprint of the normalized signature; the first tier of layered clustering (ADR-0007 decision 4).

facets.description: Optional structured facets of the signature. Content is data: the kernel stores and hashes it but never interprets it.

problem_signature.description: The problem signature this pattern answers, in the same shape as research-case-package/v2.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold before applying the pattern. May be an explicit empty array.

contraindications.description: When not to use this pattern. May be an explicit empty array; an empty array asserts none are known, it does not assert none exist.

successful_tactics.description: Tactics the source cases show working; at least one, because a pattern without any positive tactic carries no reusable content.

failed_tactics.description: Tactics the source cases show failing. May be an explicit empty array.

grade.description: Evidence grade label. The grade vocabulary is taxonomy data, not a schema enum (ADR-0007 decision 4); all Phase 4 evidence is synthetic or de-identified level and must be labeled as such.

evidence.description: Distilled evidence judgment. The underlying evidence records stay reachable through source_cases and their case packages; they are not re-referenced here.

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence label for this version of the pattern.

source_cases.description: The case packages this pattern is distilled from, each hash-pinned to research-case-package/v2 records; at least one. Promotion discipline (multiple independent cases by default; single-case exception only into candidate_pattern with reproduction, counterfactual fix, and independent review) is registry policy, not schema shape.

last_validated.description: When this version was last re-validated; surfaced by retrieval so staleness is visible at use time.

status.description: Snapshot of this version's lifecycle state (plan Phase 4 task 8, underscore style). The Phase 4 ceiling is active_pattern. A transition never edits a record: it publishes a successor version.

transition_rationale.description: Why this version exists. Mandatory for every version, including the initial one, so the lifecycle chain is self-explanatory.

supersedes.description: Optional pattern_id of the prior version this one supersedes. ID-only lineage reference within the pattern family; earlier versions are never edited in place.

promoted_skill.description: Reserved pointer to a promoted canonical skill. Phase 4 has no promotion path: registry policy rejects any populated value in this phase. The field exists now so a later promotion phase needs no schema change (plan Phase 4 task 7).
